title: Stirring Up the Gift Within
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he teaches on the importance of experiencing a constant infilling of the Holy Spirit in our lives, and how this refreshing presence of God brings breakthrough, change, and life in the midst of trials and tribulations. Discover how the presence of God can revive and restore you, and learn how to stir up the gift of the Holy Spirit that lives on the inside of you. Tonight's sermon is a powerful reminder that with God's presence, we can face anything life throws our way.
